::: {.unit-header}
# 🌋 Unit 3: Earthquakes, Tsunamis, and Volcanoes: Who's at Risk?
**What locations on Earth are most at risk of loss of life and property caused by an earthquake, volcanic eruption, or tsunami in the near future? Why do populations live in these risky areas?**
:::

## Anchor Phenomenon

> **Major earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and tsunamis happen all over the world, causing loss of life and property, yet humans have been living continuously in these hazardous areas for thousands of years.**
>
> In 2011, an earthquake and tsunami in Japan caused a nuclear disaster that we are still recovering from. In 2022, a volcanic eruption at Tonga was heard thousands of miles away and produced a massive tsunami. Natural disasters caused by tectonic plate movement, like these, are not new to Earth's history, and have long played a part in human societies.

## Unit Driving Question

> **What locations on Earth are most at risk of loss of life and property caused by an earthquake, volcanic eruption, or tsunami in the near future? Why do populations live in these risky areas?**

**Performance task:** The United Nations, non-profits, and governments have limited money to reduce disaster risk. Investigate seismic disasters to **model how they occur**, **explain how they have affected populations** in five at-risk regions (the Mediterranean Basin, the Great Rift Valley, the Japanese Archipelago, Mainland Southeast Asia, and the Andes), and explain how technology and preparedness can guide where resources go.

## Unit Storyline

| Lesson | Question |
|---|---|
| [Unit Opening](unit3-opening.qmd) | Who's at risk from earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and tsunamis, and why do people live there? |
| [Earth's Interior](unit3-earth-interior.qmd) | Where did the material for new islands come from after Krakatoa erupted? |
| [Surface Features & Plate Boundaries](unit3-plate-boundaries.qmd) | Why does seismic activity happen in some areas more than others? |
| [Energy and Matter](unit3-energy-matter.qmd) | Where is all the energy coming from to move plates apart? What processes inside Earth can cause it to reach the surface? And why do people continue to live in these hazardous areas? |
| [Unit Closing](unit3-closing.qmd) | What locations on Earth are most at risk of loss of life and property in the near future? |

## What You'll Figure Out

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

::: {.key-idea}
- 🌐 **Explain** how seismic waves reveal Earth's layers, and how density sorted those layers
- 🏝️ **Model** how the rock cycle brings material from Earth's interior to the surface to build new islands
- 🧭 **Use** patterns in seismic activity and ocean-floor age as evidence for plate tectonics
- 🌋 **Explain** why the strongest earthquakes, eruptions, and tsunamis happen at convergent plate boundaries
- 🔥 **Model** how radioactive decay and mantle convection move energy and matter to drive plate motion
- ⛏️ **Explain** why tectonically active regions are also rich in resources, and why people live there
- 🛡️ **Explain** how technology and preparedness reduce the impact of hazards, and use that to decide where resources should go
:::
